note: Small RV park on the O'Kelley farm at 2149 Pisgah Hwy, Candler, at the foot of Mt. Pisgah and the Blue Ridge Parkway, about 15 miles from downtown Asheville; creekside spaces, pets welcome. The website gives only an email address. The phone is from its Google Maps listing, and Pisgah View RV Park next door (2138 Pisgah Hwy) lists the same number on RoverPass. --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed 10 full-hookup 50/30-amp sites for most any size RV, Wi-Fi, and the posted $50 nightly / $250 weekly / $800 monthly (fees left as recorded; the page is undated). Cleared laundry and dump (not on the operator's pages). Note trimmed of hookup/site/facility text. Google Maps: 4.4 stars / 31 reviews, phone 828-702-1973 (matches the entry). Not stated: season, booking method beyond an email address, Helene status.
flags: Rate undated: the operator's rate page ('Nightly $50.00 / WEEKLY $250.00 / MONTHLY $800.00') carries no year and the site footer says '© 2023'; no 2024+ dated rate exists. $50 is at, not over, the US$50 line; within 23 km of the Asheville gateway anyway. Family has not stayed here.

No post-Helene word on the operator's site (the French Broad basin and Pisgah Hwy area flooded in Sept 2024); Google Maps lists it as an RV park with 31 reviews and phone 828-702-1973. Presence passes on the working website plus Google's phone, but open status is not confirmed by the operator.
Phone: the operator's website lists only okelleyfarm@gmail.com; the entry's 828-702-1973 is from Google Maps.
